title: Noccalula Falls Campground

services.name: Park Admission & Mini Golf
services.desc: Encompassing 500 acres in the foothills of the Appalachian Mountains, Noccalula Falls Park and Campground is a landmark destination in Northeast Alabama. Created by the City of Gadsden and managed by Noccalula Falls Park staff, the park originally opened in 1953 and welcomes hikers, campers, and families from around the world. February 16th - October 24th Daily hours: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM Extended summer hours on Saturday & Sunday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM (June and July) Park Hours could be affected by Special Events.
